channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Breaking: United Kingdom CPI inflation rises to 3.1% YoY in August, as expected
item.description: The United Kingdom (UK) headline Consumer Price Index (CPI) climbed 3.1% over the year in August, compared to a rise of 2.9% in June, the data released by the Office for National Statistics (ONS) showed on Wednesday.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah gains as US Dollar weakens ahead of Fed rate decision
item.description: USD/IDR halts its four-day winning streak, trading around 17,740 during Asian hours on Wednesday. The pair depreciates as the US Dollar (USD) declines ahead of the interest rate decision by the Federal Reserve (Fed).

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: 1.1500 to remain key support level for Fed’s Day
item.description: The Euro (EUR) trades with caution at around 1.1545 against the US Dollar (USD) during the early European trading session on Wednesday. The major currency pair is expected to remain under pressure as the Federal Reserve (Fed) is scheduled to announce the monetary policy decision at 18:00 GMT.

item.title: Indian Rupee clings to recent losses ahead of Fed’s policy
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) holds onto over-a-week long losses against the US Dollar (USD) in the opening session on Wednesday.

item.title: Gold sticks to modest gains below $4,350 as USD bulls await Fed rate decision
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) struggles to capitalize on its modest intraday move higher and remains below the $4,350 level through the Asian session on Wednesday. The US Dollar (USD) pauses for a breather after touching a two-week high and offers some support to the commodity.

item.title: WTI tumbles to near $100.00 on surprise US inventory build despite supply disruption worries
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), the US crude oil benchmark, is trading around $100.00 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. WTI falls after an unexpected build in US crude inventories.

item.title: Japanese Yen remains depressed near one-week low vs USD as traders await Fed, BoJ
item.description: The USD/JPY pair attracts some buyers for the third straight day and touches a one-week high, around the 155.45-155.50 region, during the Asian session on Wednesday. Spot prices, however, lack follow-through as traders seem hesitant ahead of the key central bank event.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in India on Wednesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: Asian stocks trade with modest gains as investors remain cautious ahead of Fed decision
item.description: Asian equity markets trade with modest gains on Wednesday, tracking stability in US stock index futures, though sentiment remains cautious ahead of the highly anticipated US Federal Reserve (Fed) policy decision.

item.title: Swiss Franc edges higher as US Dollar declines despite Fed rate hike bets
item.description: USD/CHF halts its five-day winning streak, trading around 0.8180 during Asian hours on Wednesday. The pair inches lower as the US Dollar (USD) depreciates ahead of the interest rate decision by the Federal Reserve (Fed).

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Holds gains above 110.50, but maintains bearish bias below 100-day SMA
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross trades in positive territory around 110.70 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday.

item.title: US Treasury Yields take a breather after recent rally, Fed’s policy in focus
item.description: United States (US) Treasury Yields have hit a pause after posting a fresh multi-year high on Tuesday ahead of the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary policy announcement later in the day.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar drops as RBNZ’s Silk to exit in December
item.description: NZD/USD extends its losses for the third consecutive day, trading around 0.5750 during Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: Australian Dollar weakens below 0.7150 as markets brace for Fed rate decision
item.description: The AUD/USD pair declines to around 0.7120 during Asian trading hours on Wednesday. Expectations of a US interest rate hike provide some support to the US Dollar (USD) and act as a headwind for the pair. Traders brace for the US Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate decision later on Wednesday.

item.title: PBOC’s Pan says will rely less on loan growth targets and more on rate tools to guide policy
item.description: The People’s Bank of China (PBOC) Governor Pan Gongsheng said on Wednesday that the Chinese central bank will rely less on loan growth targets and more on interest rate tools to guide policy.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD bears have the upper hand below $64.00 and 200-day EMA
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) struggles to capitalize on the previous day's modest gains and fails to break above the $64.00 round figure during the Asian session on Wednesday.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Holds ground above 179.00 within oversold territory
item.description: EUR/JPY gains ground for the third successive day, trading around 179.10 during Asian hours on Wednesday. Technical analysis of the daily chart shows the currency cross trading within a descending channel, keeping the overall bias bearish.

item.title: United States Dollar Index gains ground ahead of Fed interest rate decision
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is continuing its winning streak for the sixth consecutive day and trading around 99.70 during Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: Euro sticks to losses near one-month low as USD bulls retain control ahead of Fed decision
item.description: The EUR/USD pair sticks to a negative bias for the fifth straight day and trades around the 1.1535-1.1530 area during the Asian session on Wednesday.

item.title: British Pound softens below 1.3500 as traders await UK CPI data, Fed rate decision
item.description: The GBP/USD pair loses ground to near 1.3470 during the early Asian trading hours on Wednesday. The US Dollar (USD) strengthens against the British Pound (GBP) on expectations of a US interest rate hike.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7628 vs. 6.7670 previous
item.description: On Wednesday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.7628 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.7670 and 6.7148euters estimate.

item.title: Canadian Dollar languishes near two-week low as bullish USD offsets oil gains ahead of Fed
item.description: The USD/CAD pair retains its positive bias for the sixth straight day, trading near the 1.3930 area, a two-week high during the Asian session on Wednesday amid a bullish US Dollar (USD).

item.title: WTI slips to near $100.50 despite escalating Middle East supply disruptions
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price declines after two days of gains, trading around $100.50 per barrel during Asian hours on Wednesday. However, crude oil prices may rebound, driven by a series of broadening supply disruptions across the Middle East.

item.title: Saudi air defenses intercept Houthi drone near Mecca
item.description: The Saudi-led coalition said that Saudi air defenses intercepted and destroyed a drone launched by Yemen’s Houthi group near Mecca, Reuters reported on Tuesday.

item.title: Japanese Yen flatlines ahead of Fed rate decicion
item.description: The USD/JPY pair holds steady near 155.25 during the early Asian session on Wednesday. Traders prefer to wait on the sidelines ahead of the US Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate decision later on Wednesday. On Friday, attention will shift to the Bank of Japan (BoJ) interest rate decision.

item.title: Gold declines below $4,300 as US yields climb, Fed rate decision looms
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) declines to near $4,285 during the early Asian session on Wednesday.

item.title: Australian Dollar softens as risk-off mood meets FOMC countdown
item.description: The Aussie Dollar loses 0.11% against the Greenback on Tuesday as risk appetite remains negative amid calls from AI company CEOs to slow development, while the FOMC monetary policy meeting looms. Expectations for a Fed rate hike undermine the AUD/USD, which trades at 0.7130.

item.title: The Euro edges lower as Frankfurt's hike takes effect the day Washington votes
item.description: EUR/USD closed Tuesday near 1.1540, down 0.1%. It fell on the day the European Central Bank (ECB) raised its deposit rate to 2.50% and in each of the three sessions since.

item.title: GBP/JPY Price Forecast: Rebounds above 207.00 as oversold risk eases
item.description: The GBP/JPY edges higher by about 0.29% on Tuesday, even as risk appetite has shifted to the sour side due to geopolitical developments that are driving global bond yields higher amid inflation fears. At the time of writing, the cross-pair trades at 209.02 after bouncing off daily lows of 208.25.

item.title: The Pound drifts lower as the Fed lines up a rate above the Bank of England's
item.description: GBP/USD closed Tuesday near 1.3470, down 0.2%. Wednesday's Asian and London hours are the last before the Fed is expected to raise its rate for the first time since July 2023. By the New York close its ceiling should sit a quarter-point above Bank Rate.
